summary: Tested Login page (duplicate button fix) and Portal Deal Detail page (LoopNet/Crexi-style redesign). All features verified working correctly.

login_single_button.details: Login page has exactly ONE login button (submit button). Other buttons are 'Forgot password?' and 'Request Access' links.

portal_hero_section.details: Hero section displays property image (~80% width) with agent contact sidebar (~20% on right). Layout matches LoopNet/Crexi style.

portal_agent_sidebar.details: Agent contact info displays on right side: name, company, phone, email, Contact Agent button

portal_title_price_bar.details: Property title and asking price displayed between hero and tabs

portal_tab_navigation.details: Tab navigation present: Overview, Documents (with count), Location

portal_unified_overview.details: Property Overview section merges physical facts and financial details into one unified grid. Shows: Asking Price, Building Size, Lot Size, Land SQFT, Zoning, Cap Rate, NOI, Annual Expenses, Price/SF

portal_no_interested_cta.details: 'Interested in this property' CTA section correctly removed from page

portal_documents_section.details: Documents section present (shows 'No documents available' when empty)

portal_location_section.details: Location section with interactive OpenStreetMap map and property marker

portal_back_navigation.details: Back to Portfolio button navigates to /portal/{portalId}/map

portal_save_unsave.details: Save/Unsave toggle works - button text changes from 'Save' to 'Saved'

critical_code_review_comments: Login.js: Clean implementation with single submit button, other buttons are styled links
PortalDealDetail.js: Complete redesign matching LoopNet/Crexi style with hero section, unified overview, tabs
PortalLayout.js: Provides consistent header with DL logo and Logout button
All data-testid attributes present for testing: back-to-map, detail-save-btn, contact-agent-btn, tab-overview, tab-documents, tab-location, section-overview, section-documents, section-location
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal Deal Detail page redesigned to LoopNet/Crexi style. Hero section with 80/20 split (image/agent sidebar). Unified Property Overview section merges physical and financial facts. Tab navigation (Overview, Documents, Location). No 'Interested in this property' CTA. Session token must be set in localStorage as portal_session_{portalId} before accessing deal detail page.
